subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘HAIRCAP’ is written as ‘IAHRPAC’ and ‘LEADMAN’ is written as ‘AELDNAM’. How will ‘FACTFUL’ be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

‘HAIRCAP’ is written as ‘IAHRPAC’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dda889b9aff7f3f4650759f4a2aadd29315d89a8ac538a5e49d9f18f60a571e3.png] 

And,

'LEADMAN' is written 'ASELDNAM'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e3bfdcc1a4ef297ddc7ddc37152fa73cba77fd7bdfba506068fffb713fa5f9a.png] 

Similarly,

‘FACTFUL’ be written '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d7042388fd34e5c7fedabea11de198b41835ef031cd198995c9488090057e3c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"CAFTLUF".**
